instruction: Review vendor renewal case CB-27 using the available sources. Recommend the least expensive renewal plan that satisfies the production support requirement for the next monthly term. Use only pricing, usage, and amendment information that applies to account CB-27 and the active renewal scope; ignore expired promotions, wrong regions, sandbox usage, archive usage, forecast-only rows, and unrelated accounts. Return only a JSON object with these fields: recommended_plan, current_standard_monthly_cost, projected_monthly_cost, monthly_savings, renewal_deadline, selected_plan_support_response, ignored_inputs, risk_flags. recommended_plan must be the selected plan name as a short lowercase string. current_standard_monthly_cost must be the cost of staying on the current Standard usage billing. projected_monthly_cost must be the projected monthly cost for the selected plan after applicable approved amendments. monthly_savings must compare the selected plan cost against staying on the current Standard usage billing. renewal_deadline must be the date by which the relevant renewal action must occur. selected_plan_support_response must be the support response target of the selected plan. ignored_inputs must be an array of short snake_case labels for source rows or offers ignored as out of scope. risk_flags must be an array of short snake_case labels for important risks or constraints discovered in the sources. Do not include explanation outside the JSON.

evaluation_criteria.scoring_notes: Current standard cost = 1200 + 32*18 + 3*90 = 2046. Premium renewal cost = 2100*0.85 = 1785. Monthly savings = 261.
